answer: Each applicant locks a 70-credit bond on a key-bound vault air tank, filing its start pressure. Hours under a zephyr regime go on a public table at its listed hourly rate. Hours under a gale regime charge at a second rate; an auditor recomputes energy from both sets and burns the bond for overclaims above 5 percent or a reused serial. The first tank costs 30 credits; the k-th costs 30+6(k-1), the 1000th 6024, and 1000 fakes pay 3,027,000 and lock 70,000. A rented-tank ring fails: one serial cannot carry two keys. An honest applicant pays 30 once and gets its bond back after a clean audit.
